# List.Skip

```m
List.Skip(list as list, optional countOrCondition as any) as list
```

Returns a list that skips the specified number of elements at the beginning of the list.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/list-skip)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | `list` | no |
| `countOrCondition` | `any` | yes |
